History:
29-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2024, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 27 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 4.5 (moderate disease activity).
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
